md.source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flag_of_Moldova.svg (revision of 2026-03-31, sha1 869c141fd01ec0ae4f6d911b535b1e6e18049e74), by Gheorghe Vrabie, drawn after Law no. 217 of 17 September 2010 on the State Flag of the Republic of Moldova
md.reason: The coat of arms in flag-icons is a rough drawing (leaf-like branch, club-shaped talons, a misplaced beak and eye). The Commons flag follows the law: the three bands are #0046AE, #FFD200 and #CC092F, and the arms are the original drawing scaled uniformly to 60% of the flag height and centred on three equal bands, as flag-icons composes its 4x3 flags.
